g.text: Null-space energy placement accompanies lower activation range and quantization error. All 28 Llama-3.2-3B down-input layers are

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: shown for Hadamard, DuQuant and PrismQuant at maximal alignment rank. (a) Whole-activation energy fraction in the groupwise

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: quantizer null space; the dashed reference is 1/128. (b) Paired mean group range. (c) Dynamic asymmetric group-128 INT4

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: activation NMSE. The arithmetic means of per-layer PrismQuant-versus-Hadamard percentage reductions are 25.30% and 40.41%,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: respectively. These are descriptive layer measurements, without inferred seed confidence intervals. DuQuant denotes the existing

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: DuQuant-style diagnostic, not the complete official implementation. The shared legend applies to all panels.
